title: Image overlap pptx 002
notes: honest category divergence (same call as 001): PPTX has NO text-wrap concept, so this is a z-order overlap test. 002 mirrors 001's geometry instead of repeating it: an opaque SLATE 96x72 PNG (deterministic PIL bytes, different size and fill from 001's ink 64x48) is placed at the RIGHT (4.6in, 2.4in, 3.6in x 2.6in) with a pic:descr alt-text string, and a four-line word-wrapped frame added SECOND enters from the upper-left (1.0in, 1.2in), overlapping the picture's upper-left corner — the opposite corner from 001. Later shape still paints on top (asserted: p:pic precedes the p:sp). The picture carries no text; reference_text is the four frame lines (three in 001).
